selected_contract.signed_weight_representation: differential pair; effective multilevel weight precision is assumed, not demonstrated
selected_contract.input_representation: signed DAC voltage assumed; no input bit serialization
selected_contract.readout: analog differential subtraction before one signed ADC per logical column

adc_range.method: maximum absolute quantized training partial times fixed headroom, capped at conservative bound

selected_contract.accumulation: digital float32 sum across row tiles and digital bias addition
selected_contract.calibration_status: training-activation numerical calibration; no physical converter calibration

energy_latency.energy_equation: E_projection = N_DAC*e_DAC + N_ADC*e_ADC + N_array*e_array + N_add*e_add + bytes*e_move; add programming/calibration amortization
energy_latency.break_even: E_projection plus integration overhead must be below same-target digital projection energy

required_unqualified_hardware: per-tile programmable gain or ADC reference
selected_contract.noise_interpretation: read_noise_fraction remains relative to each selected range; this does not preserve a fixed absolute physical noise floor

selection_rule: lowest ADC bit count among calibrated candidates passing the unchanged validation screen

screen.status: provisional engineering screen inherited before this run

numerical_control.rationale: Check local arithmetic directly; log probabilities remove arbitrary per-position logit offsets. Bound every vocabulary probability ratio by exp(0.001), plus exact decisions and tighter mean target loss.
numerical_control.prior_run: 20260909-wikitext-sampled remains rejected under its original raw-logit criterion

context_selection: evenly spaced eligible nonoverlapping blocks after excluding every previously scored context
calibration_policy: reuse exact frozen training activation tensor and range contract; no holdout fitting
claim_boundary: Previously unscored token contexts, not necessarily unseen articles or absent from model pretraining. No hardware qualification.
